title: A Coherent Memory Register for Sequential Quantum Generative Modeling, with Application to Calorimeter Showers
summary: Simulating the showers that particles deposit in a calorimeter, the detector that records their energy across many cells, is one of the largest computing costs in high-energy physics, and fast generative surrogates are needed. Quantum circuits have been proposed as such surrogates, but demonstrations on calorimeter data have either required a register that grows with the image, roughly one qubit per cell, or have passed the information between parts of the image through a classical channel.
